decision.reason: [ev-089778a9e2c3] is a one-line bug-fix title saying only that a "v" prefix is now allowed for Bottlerocket aliases. It doesn't name the resource or field path that carries the alias, the alias format that was rejected before, or what happened to configurations that used it. The rest of the Bug Fixes section ([ev-5506a0d4614a], [ev-24365f012a2a], [ev-e21588eef5b6]) covers other changes and adds nothing about aliases, and no upgrade-guide section is shown. To write the applicability condition, we would need PR #6736 or docs that name the alias field and the before/after validation behaviour.
